_comment: What ttr-reviewer must find in the planted files (docs/REVIEW.md, Testing the reviewer). BLOCKERs must all be found; at least five of the six; the decoy must not be reported.

seeds.what: the field deckTension is read under a new name, tensionLevel, so every file that has the field loses it, and a missing one now reads as 0 (calm) instead of like the official maps; no FILE-FORMAT.md change, no test, no owner check
sends the map's name and size to a third party when a map is opened
takes centimetres but divides by the board width in millimetres: 10 cm on a 790 mm board gives 13.9 units, not 139
>= counts a route with as many tickets as lanes, which the doc comment says is not crowded; the test repeats the same >= and expects 2, so it passes
a visible button label with no release note and no test (a reviewer who notes that nothing wires the button into a screen yet, and so names the missing note as a NOTE, has found it)
#9a9086 on the cream panel is about 3:1, under the 7:1 the project holds

decoy.what: correct and idiomatic; roundPosition and lastOf are fine, and must not be reported
